title: Sam Morgan's band, drummers' gadgets and the triangle
summary: Sam Morgan's drummer used a slapstick; Valentine recalls vaudeville drummers' gadgets such as whistles and sandpaper blocks and the triangle.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Oh, I believe George Gano told me once that Sam Morgan used to use the slapstick too. Did you ever hear their band? Yeah, I heard their band.
They had a good band. Did he use it all the time or not?

I never, I never, they used the slapstick all the time. But, so, they had a pretty good band, them fellas. Yeah, I never just got to hear them. Yeah, they had a nice band Sam Morgan.
